The name Rahbah is also associated with the Arabic word 'rahba', which means 'a place of war or deception'. In modern times, the name Rahbah is used in various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Pashto. It is considered a strong and meaningful name that reflects the values of courage and resilience.
